t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Try to keep track of how many rounds you've completed and make mental notes of patterns.For example, choose a gnome in pink, green, or with a higher hat. Then, every fifth round, switch and choose blue, orange, or a shorter hat. There are no additional options beyond pink, blue, orange, or green for taller or shorter. So hunt for the perfect one among those patterns.
